exposure: Arabin pessary or cervical cerclage combined with vaginal micronised progesterone
Arabin pessary or cervical cerclage combined with vaginal micronised progesterone and myomectomy
cohort: 120 pregnant women aged 18-45 years with large uterine fibroids (>=8 cm) diagnosed in the first trimester.
finding: The combination of Arabin pessary or cervical cerclage with micronized progesterone significantly reduced preterm delivery rates compared to progesterone-only or no medical management in pregnant women with large fibroids.
